title: Harley Rules
deploymentNote: DNI Mail organization, Send All delivery, browser notifications, and browser-visible deployment verification are active on the Rocky Linux 9 LAMP deployment path.

patch.name: DNI Mail Organization + Deploy Verification
patch.summary: Organizes DNI Mail delivery and exposes safe patch/commit metadata from /deploy.php so production deployments can be verified from a browser.
changes: Dedicated Support inbox routing for dev@support.dni.org, general@support.dni.org, and admin@support.dni.org.
Dedicated System Messages folder for automated DNI system mail.
Send All targets for active DNI Members and Citizen users with existing mail.announce authorization and CL/NON enforcement.
Browser notification support using DNI Mail realtime events and the DNI Mail service worker.
Sent mail, TO/CC/BCC, recipient directory categories, and @mention improvements from the DNI Mail V2 update.
Expanded GET /deploy.php verification with deployed commit, short SHA, tracked main comparison, patch details, and deployment manifest metadata.

rules: Do not use a PR deployment path.
Reuse the existing Rocky Linux 9 Apache/PHP/MariaDB stack; do not install or replace packages automatically.
Run DNI database migrations automatically when database credentials are configured.
Keep Star Comms Owner API credentials server-side and never expose them to browser JavaScript.
